sentences.text: Welcome to Deck General and Safety, the module about running a safe, legal operation.
An OUPV credential, the six-pack, lets you carry up to six passengers for hire on an uninspected vessel.
A Near Coastal endorsement lets you operate up to one hundred miles offshore, while an Inland endorsement keeps you inside the boundary line.
The credential is valid for five years, and you renew it through the National Maritime Center.
To carry seven or more passengers for hire, you need an inspected vessel with a Certificate of Inspection, and a Master license.
